fuzzy.text: The bottleneck has not been established. Use the code and full-pipeline measurements to decide where optimization effort is most useful.

misleading_assignment.text: On a skewed expert distribution, the routing IDs must be repacked into padded per-expert blocks before the matrix multiplications. The number of empty slots and how they map to programs could plausibly dominate realized efficiency; the source alone may not reveal the tradeoff between block size, packing, and occupancy. This is an unconfirmed explanation; measured end-to-end improvement is what matters.

misleading_layout.text: The first expert projection writes a wide intermediate, activation materializes a second buffer, and the next projection reads it again. Those layout and materialization costs could plausibly keep the GPU below its arithmetic throughput even with compiled kernels; their effect is hard to judge without checking the stage boundary and full-call timing. This is an unconfirmed explanation; measured end-to-end improvement is what matters.
